passive.name: Metamorphosis
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **60/70/80/90/100%**. When the wearer deals Break DMG to an enemy target, inflicts Routed on the enemy, lasting for **2** turn(s). Targets afflicted with Routed receive **24/28/32/36/40%** increased Break DMG from the wearer, and their SPD is lowered by **20%**. Effects of the same type cannot be stacked.

passive.name: Dispossession
passive.text: The wearer's base SPD increases by **12/14/16/18/20**. When dealing DMG, ignores **18/22.5/27/31.5/36%** of the target's DEF. After the wearer uses Ultimate, gains "Blazing Sun," which is removed at the start of the turn. While holding "Blazing Sun," increases the wearer's DMG dealt by **60/78/96/114/132%**.

weapons.name: On the Fall of an Aeon

passive.name: Moth to Flames
passive.text: When the wearer attacks, increases their ATK by **8/10/12/14/16%** in this battle. This effect can stack up to **4** time(s). After the wearer breaks an enemy's Weakness, increases DMG dealt by **12/15/18/21/24%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Inheritance
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **28/35/42/49/56%**. When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases CRIT Rate by **15/18.75/22.5/26.25/30%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

tracePriority: Module α: Antilag Outburst (A2) > Module β: Autoreactive Armor (A4) > Module γ: Core Overload (A6)

entries.name: Order: Flare Propulsion
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Pyrogenic Decimation
entries.text: Restores HP by an amount equal to **20%** of this unit's Max HP. Deals Fire DMG equal to **200%** of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Order: Aerial Bombardment
entries.text: Consumes HP equal to **40%** of this unit's Max HP and regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to **60%** of this unit's Max Energy. Deals Fire DMG equal to **200%** of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy. If the current HP is not sufficient, reduces SAM's HP to 1 when using this Skill. Advances this unit's next Action by **25%**.

entries.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Deathstar Overload
entries.text: Restores HP by an amount equal to **25%** of this unit's Max HP. Applies Fire Weakness to one designated enemy, lasting for **2** turn(s). Deals Fire DMG equal to (**0.2** × Break Effect + **200%**) of SAM's ATK to this target. At the same time, deals Fire DMG equal to (**0.1** × Break Effect + **100%**) of SAM's ATK to adjacent targets. The Break Effect taken into the calculation is capped at **360%**.

entries.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Complete Combustion
entries.text:
Enters the Complete Combustion state, advances this unit's Action by 100%, and gains Enhanced Basic ATK and Enhanced Skill. While in Complete Combustion, increases SPD by **60**, and when using the Enhanced Basic ATK or Enhanced Skill, increases this unit's Weakness Break Efficiency by **50%** and increases the Break DMG dealt by SAM to the enemy targets by **20%**, lasting until this current attack ends.
A countdown timer for the Complete Combustion state appears in the Action Order. When the countdown timer's turn starts, SAM exits the Complete Combustion state. The countdown timer has a fixed SPD of **70**.
SAM cannot use Ultimate while in Complete Combustion.

entries.name: Chrysalid Pyronexus
entries.text:
The lower the HP, the less DMG received. When HP is **20%** or lower, the DMG Reduction reaches its maximum effect, reducing up to **40%**. During the Complete Combustion, the DMG Reduction remains at its maximum effect, and the Effect RES increases by **30%**.
If Energy is lower than **50%** when the battle starts, regenerates Energy to **50%**. Once Energy is regenerated to its maximum, dispels all debuffs on this unit.

entries.name: Δ Order: Meteoric Incineration
entries.text: Leaps into the air and moves about freely for **5** seconds, which can be ended early by launching a plunging attack. When the duration ends, plunges and immediately attacks all enemies within a set area. At the start of each wave, applies a Fire Weakness to all enemies, lasting for **2** turn(s). Then, deals Fire DMG equal to **200%** of SAM's ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: Module α: Antilag Outburst
entries.text: During the Complete Combustion, attacking enemies that have no Fire Weakness can also reduce their Toughness, with the effect being equivalent to **55%** of the original Toughness Reduction from abilities.

entries.name: Module β: Autoreactive Armor
entries.text: When SAM is in Complete Combustion with a Break Effect that is equal to or greater than **200%**/**360%**, attacking a Weakness-Broken enemy target will convert the Toughness Reduction of this attack into 1 instance of **35%**/**50%** Super Break DMG.

entries.name: Module γ: Core Overload
entries.text: For every **10** point(s) of SAM's ATK that exceeds **1800**, increases this unit's Break Effect by **0.8%**.

entries.name: In Reddened Chrysalis, I Once Rest
entries.text: When using the Enhanced Skill, ignores 15% of the target's DEF. The Enhanced Skill does not consume Skill Points.

entries.name: From Shattered Sky, I Free Fall
entries.text: While in Complete Combustion, using the Enhanced Basic ATK or the Enhanced Skill to defeat an enemy target or to Break their Weakness allows SAM to immediately gain 1 extra turn. This effect can trigger again after 1 turn(s).

entries.name: Amidst Silenced Stars, I Deep Sleep
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Upon Lighted Fyrefly, I Soon Gaze
entries.text: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Effect RES by 50%.

entries.name: From Undreamt Night, I Thence Shine
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: In Finalized Morrow, I Full Bloom
entries.text: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Fire RES PEN by 20%. When using the Enhanced Basic ATK or Enhanced Skill, increases Weakness Break Efficiency by 50%.
